programme.title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
programme.desc: The globetrotting presenter arrives in Japan, where he meets a dedicated Monty Python fan, receives a beating in a Zen monastery, before visiting Nagasaki - where the second atom bomb was dropped in 1945. He then heads to the South Korean capital Seoul, where he attends a wedding ceremony, before briefly crossing the border into North Korea at the Joint Security Area in Panmunjeom

programme.title: Miss Marple

programme.desc: Part one of three. A couple wake up to find the strangled corpse of a young woman in their library, and turn to their neighbour Miss Jane Marple to investigate the murder. She agrees to investigate but, as her inquiries get under way, another body is discovered. Agatha Christie mystery, starring Joan Hickson and Gwen Watford

programme.title: The Seventh Seal (1957)
programme.desc: A disillusioned knight returns home from the Crusades to find his home ravaged by the Black Death. He is soon confronted by the Grim Reaper, who tells him it is his time. In order to prolong his life, he challenges the spectral figure to a game of chess, and as they play, he reflects on life, death and the existence of God. Ingmar Bergman's drama, starring Max von Sydow and Bengt Ekerot. In Swedish and Latin

programme.title: Arena

The programme also features a 2003 interview n which Bergman talks about the personal visions that make up an unrivalled body of work in cinema and theatre. First broadcast in 2007

programme.title: Shakespeare: Rise of a Genius

But as his star rises, a series of disasters and setbacks strike, throwing Shakespeare's life, purpose and family into chaos. Narrated by Juliet Stevenson, with contributions from Judi Dench, Brian Cox, Adrian Lester, Lolita Chakrabarti, Helen Mirren, Martin Freeman and Jessie

Derek recalls how working under Zeffirelli with such an impressive cast made for one of his personal career highlights, helped in no small part by the presence of Maggie Smith on stage and the friendship they enjoyed behind the curtain

Whether trying to impress the World?s Strongest Woman with their strength, talking to nettles in an eco-village, living like Stone Age cavemen or stripping naked in front of 1,000 women, Will and Ralf challenge themselves and each other to learn new things and to push themselves to do and be better. Along the way, stuck in the car for hours with only a satnav and a bespoke playlist to distract them, they bond not just through reminiscing about the good old days and indulging in in-car karaoke, but also through talking about where they are now as middle-aged men and opening up to each other

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys

programme.desc: PC Dan Casper arrives at Sun Hill, and immediately risks life and limb to rescue a girl attempting to kill herself on a dual carriageway. programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: JT unwittingly puts a woman's life in jeopardy by sending her to the house of serial rapist Alan Kennedy, forcing Samantha and Terry to abandon a covert surveillance operation and rush to her rescue. programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Ramani is convinced someone at the station was responsible for the hoax call to her ex-boyfriend, but Roger is sceptical and begins to worry about her state of mind. Lance and Sheelagh's drugs investigation on the Cole Lane Estate takes an ugly turn when an elderly man is attacked and suspicion falls on two local dealers - one of whom is subsequently shot dead. Serial rapist Alan Kennedy is assaulted by a friend of his first victim and responds by making a chilling phone call to Samantha

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Mickey Webb, now working with the National Crime Squad, returns to Sun Hill and tells Jack he suspects Neil has ensured the silence of a key witness in a major money laundering trial. programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part one of two. Neil's world begins to collapse around his ears when his meeting with a key witness in the money laundering trial is followed by her attempted kidnapping. Already paranoid after discovering a bug in his house and an intruder rummaging through his rubbish, the confused copper begins to wonder if somebody's trying to frame him - and his suspicions are confirmed when he's beaten up, drugged and awakes to find himself next to a murdered man

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Part two of two. As Neil is hauled into custody on a murder charge, mutual mistrust begins to brew between the Sun Hill regulars and the National Crime Squad team led by Mickey Webb. Ever resourceful, Neil pretends to have hard evidence that a corrupt copper is responsible for his predicament - deliberately provoking an attempt on his own life as a way of proving his innocence

programme.title: 999 Rescue Squad
